summary: Autodesk, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $1.0 billion senior unsecured notes offering: $500 million of 5.050% notes due September 15, 2029, and $500 million of 5.650% notes due September 15, 2033. Notes were priced at 99.869 and 99.844, respectively, for gross proceeds of $998.565 million and net proceeds of $993.190 million after $5.375 million underwriting discount. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning March 15, 2027. Joint book-running managers include Morgan Stanley, BNP Paribas, Citigroup, BofA Securities, and US Bancorp. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
